about.heading: About Me
about.intro: Hello, I'm José Rafael Gutierrez, a family man with a lovely wife and two children growing up.
about.closing: I've long worked as a custom web-systems developer. I'm into electronics, technology, science, and reading. I value the personal growth that comes from family life. I enjoy chess, good music, and film, but more than anything, I value time with my loved ones.

skills.heading: Skills & Abilities
skills.intro: Throughout my career as a developer, I've gained skills that have pushed me forward. For example, I prefer simplifying problems rather than complicating them. I'm committed and give my best in everything I do. I'm proactive, always taking the initiative and wanting to learn and improve every day. Perseverance is one of my strengths, and I know how to handle frustration well. I have a solid foundation in object-oriented programming and can quickly adapt to new technologies.

facts.heading: Facts
facts.intro: Throughout my career as a web developer, I've had wins and successes that are genuinely worth highlighting.

summary.heading: Summary
summary.bio: Innovative web developer with more than 13 years of experience designing, developing, and deploying software systems as solutions for the public and private sectors.

services.heading: Services
services.comingSoon: The details of the services I offer are coming soon — check back later.

vtexApiPhp.title: Library for consuming Vtex Framework APIs
vtexApiPhp.body: This library was built to consume ecommerce stores built on the Vtex Framework, speeding up integrations between those stores and their sales/inventory systems (SAP, Intelisis, WinPOS, among others) through PHP or Laravel applications.
vtexApiPhp.whatIsVtexBody: VTEX is an ecommerce platform that helps companies build their own online store and sell their products. With this tool you can design your digital store, manage products, receive purchase orders, process payments, and consolidate all your customers' information.

generalSettings.title: Library for managing general settings in a Laravel application
generalSettings.body: The GeneralSettings package for Laravel lets you manage general settings in a Laravel application without worrying about data casting, encryption, views, routes, or controllers. With a couple of commands and a few clicks you get an excellent module for managing your application's general parameters and settings.
